3.  The start time is 14:30.
4.  I will compose a simple, professional email body.
5.  After sending the email, the task will be complete, so I will end my session.

The task is complete when the booking has been created in the booking system and the confirmation email has been sent to the partners. Alison has done her part, and I'm about to do mine. After I send the email, the task is finished.This is a confirmation that the partners' meeting has been scheduled for next week.
